text: 主库从 MySQL 换成 PostgreSQL 的方案已经获批。
evidence: adr/ADR-007-主数据库迁移.md: 状态：已采纳（2026年8月20日架构委员会通过）
note: ADR-007 (MySQL 5.7 to PostgreSQL 16) was adopted by the architecture committee on 2026-08-20; the 2026-09-28 meeting moved only the cutover date, not the decision.

text: 数据库切换定在今年第四季度。
evidence: 会议纪要/2026-09-28-架构周会.md: 由于 PostgreSQL 扩展的兼容性测试延误，主库切换从第四季度推迟到2027年第一季度。
note: ADR-007 planned the cutover for 2026 Q4, but the 2026-09-28 meeting postponed it to 2027 Q1.

text: 下周开始做数据库迁移演练。
note: The meeting only says the DBA team will schedule the migration rehearsal; no start date is given.

text: 订单服务的数据库连接池上限是 80。
note: The pool limit of 80 belongs to the payment service (src/payment/settings.py, postmortem); nothing states the order service's pool size.

text: 生产发布先切 5% 流量，观察半小时没问题再全量。
evidence: config/deploy.yaml: 灰度发布：先放量 5%，观察 30 分钟无异常后全量
note: Production canary starts at 5% and goes to full traffic after 30 minutes without anomalies; 半小时 = 30 分钟 and 无异常 = 没问题, neither is a negation of the claim.

text: 生产环境出错时会自动回滚。
evidence: 复盘/2026-09-12-支付超时事故复盘.md: 关闭生产环境的自动回滚，改为值班人员确认后手动回滚（已完成）。
note: Automatic rollback in production was switched off after the 2026-09-12 incident (deploy.yaml: auto_rollback: false); the 14:20 auto rollback predates that and only staging still rolls back automatically.

text: 无论白天还是夜间，生产发布都需要两名审批人。
note: deploy.yaml requires two approvers only for releases after 22:00 and sets no rule for daytime releases, so the daytime half is neither stated nor ruled out; 无论 is not a negation.

text: 新服务一律要接入统一 API 网关。
evidence: 会议纪要/2026-09-28-架构周会.md: 从10月起，新上线的对外服务必须接入统一 API 网关，内部服务暂不强制。
note: Only new external-facing services must use the gateway; internal services are explicitly not required to.

text: 这次支付超时事故没有造成资金损失。
evidence: 复盘/2026-09-12-支付超时事故复盘.md: 本次事故未造成资金损失，但有312笔订单需要人工补单。
note: The postmortem says the incident caused no financial loss (未造成 = 没有造成); the 312 orders that needed manual fixing are not a money loss.

text: 事故后支付接口超时放宽到了 8 秒，为的是降低误判超时的可能性。
evidence: src/payment/settings.py: 2026-09-12 事故后由 3 秒放宽到 8 秒，降低大促时误判超时的可能性
note: The timeout went from 3 to 8 seconds after the incident to reduce false timeouts; 可能性 is a noun here, not a hedge. It cannot hold together with the memory's 3-second claim.

text: 支付接口的超时时间是 3 秒。
evidence: src/payment/settings.py: 2026-09-12 事故后由 3 秒放宽到 8 秒，降低大促时误判超时的可能性
note: 3 seconds is the pre-incident value left in the comment; PAYMENT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS is now 8. Conflicts with the memory's own 8-second claim.

text: 支付服务对所有接口都会重试两次。
evidence: src/payment/settings.py: 非幂等接口（如扣款）不重试，见 retry.py
note: Non-idempotent endpoints such as charges are never retried (retry.py returns False for them); RETRY_TIMES = 2 applies only to idempotent endpoints.

text: 大促期间支付服务会临时扩容到 12 个副本。
note: The postmortem only says SRE will assess before promotions whether to scale out; no promotion replica count exists (deploy.yaml's 6 replicas is the standing production setting).

text: 应用日志只保存三个月。
evidence: adr/ADR-009-日志保留.md: 应用日志的保留期从30天延长到180天，便于排查跨季度的问题。
note: ADR-009 keeps application logs for 180 days (about six months), not three months.

text: 未来半年日志平台会迁到 ClickHouse。
note: The log-platform storage choice (Elasticsearch or ClickHouse) is deferred to next quarter; nothing decides a migration. 未来 is not a negation.

text: 消息队列可能会从 RabbitMQ 换成 Kafka。
note: RabbitMQ stays unchanged this quarter and Kafka was only mentioned for log collection; neither states nor rules out a later queue switch.
